*Dear Students of VTU**,*

*Greetings from Teachnook FLUXUS-IIT INDORE!*

*Reminder for ** VTU* *Students (INTRODUCING DRONE ENGINEERING TECHNOLOGY)*

*DRONES WILL BE PROVIDED IF STUDENTS ARE OPTING FOR DRONE ENGINEERING
TECHNOLOGY*

*This Internship and Training will be conducted in after your exams*

Teachnook in collaboration with *FLUXUS-IIT INDORE and IIT BOMBAY E-CELL *is
organizing a 2 Months of Training + Internship program. We are enrolling
only *LIMITED STUDENTS *in the program for* VTU.*

*It is Mandatory for interested students to fill out the form, if you get
shortlisted you will get a call from our HR Team:**Registration Form*
<https://docs.google.com/forms/u/2/d/1BKh40v5VRZdHJOjPM3sz9bfdx2WyQ4H8xoqMCb-WbeU/edit?ts=65bbe438>

*FIND THE BELOW ATTACHMENTS FOR REFERENCE:*
First month: IIT training has been designed in the form of Live lectures
along with living mentorship from industry professionals. (Login
credentials will be provided to students after registration)

Second month: Internship with live mentorship for projects from
professionals. The LIVE INDUSTRY PROJECT will be giving students experience
in solving real-world problems.

Project 1:- 10 individual projects assigned to each intern which they have
to complete with their mentor .

Project 2:-  Capstone Project: It's a group project assigned to a group of
15 interns. For each intern particular work will be assigned to them they
have to work on it.
